title: Smoke long rays, refined
desc: A 4x3 glowing construct wall throwing long rays of light from every side through haze, in four ray styles.

takes.name: As picked
takes.facts: pass 94's L1: one wide spot out of each side and the top

takes.name: Shafts
takes.facts: narrow 16 deg beams per side, haze thins by 6 blocks, glow half strength

takes.name: Streaks
takes.facts: L2 + glow broken into soft drifting rays (recommended)

takes.name: Breathing
takes.facts: L3 breathing every 4 s: reach 3-5 blocks, strength +-30%
